exposure: Prenatal exposure to 20 inorganic elements (copper, molybdenum, arsenic, barium, cadmium, calcium, cobalt, lead, lithium, magnesium, manganese, mercury, selenium, strontium, zinc, platinum, silver, thallium, uranium)
outcome: Levels of 20 inorganic elements in umbilical cord blood
cohort: The study included 172 pregnant women, comprising 79 rural and 93 urban participants, from whom umbilical cord blood was collected at delivery.
finding: Significant differences were observed in prenatal exposure to copper and molybdenum, with higher levels found in urban samples compared to rural samples.
cross-section timing: At the time of delivery (umbilical cord blood collection)
